title: bootstrap-offline-sealed-credentials-and-legacy-key-migration-tooling
author: Maya Patel
description: Adds an end-to-end offline bootstrap path for sealed secrets/credential material and a helper to migrate legacy sealed-secrets keys during air-gapped upgrades. Motivation: customers in highly regulated sites require a deterministic, verifiable way to seed controller key material and rotate keys without reaching out to external KMS. This PR introduces a signed credential bundle format, pre-seeded sealed-keys initialization hook, a migration utility script, Helm chart flags to disable automatic rotation, Terraform registry-seed module updates, preflight checks for HSM/KMS presence with clear fallbacks, and documentation and tests for the full on-prem airgap flow. Checklist: 1) vendor minimal sealed-secrets controller image and attest signatures; 2) add installer preseed manifest template and apply-time hook; 3) migration script (scripts/migrate-sealedkeys.sh) with dry-run and verify modes; 4) Helm changes to support disable-key-rotation and external-key-provider stubs; 5) terraform module to populate local OCI registry and add toggle for sealed-credential bundles; 6) integration tests for offline bootstrap and rollback; 7) docs/upgrade-offline-credentials.md and upgrade notes. Rationale: rather than reintroducing an external KMS dependency we support a signed-bundle approach where a customer-provided keypair or HSM-derived material is used to encrypt sealed-secrets controller private material, stored in the offline bundle, and applied atomically during bootstrap or upgrade. This enables air-gapped installs to remain autonomous while allowing enterprises to attest provenance of the key material.

review_comments: Luca Romano: Can we avoid vendoring the full sealed-secrets controller image blob in the repo? Suggest pulling from an OCI lockfile artifact directory that is part of the airgap bundle instead of committing binary blobs.
Maya Patel: Addressed by moving image to installer/bundles/oci-lock/ and adding a small metadata attestation file. See commit b2f9d4e.

Priya Nair: Migration script looks good but needs stronger idempotency guarantees. If controller is partially applied during upgrade we should be able to resume without reapplying secrets that are already present.
Maya Patel: migrate-sealedkeys.sh now supports --resume mode and checks existing controller secret fingerprints before applying. Added test coverage in tests/airgap.

Ben Cho: CI integration tests failed on first run due to helm-lint errors and one missing go vet check in preflight; after fixes all checks passed. Please confirm we are not relaxing security defaults.
Maya Patel: Helm defaults still enforce rotation=true by default; this PR exposes disableKeyRotation but documents recommended defaults. preflight vet added to CI pipeline.

merge_commit_message: bootstrap-offline-sealed-credentials-and-legacy-key-migration-tooling: Add signed bundles, preseed hooks, migration script, terraform registry seeder updates, helm flags and docs
release_notes: Added: offline signed credential bundle format and installer preseed support for sealed-secrets; vendor attestation metadata for sealed-secrets controller; migration utility to move legacy sealed-keys into new signed-bundle flow; Helm flags to opt out of automatic key rotation in air-gapped installs; Terraform registry-seeder toggle for credential bundles; integration tests and documentation for airgap credential lifecycle.
notes_for_ops: Operators: See docs/upgrade-offline-credentials.md for step-by-step. Typical flow: 1) create signed-credential-bundle using customer key/HSM; 2) seed the bundle into the local OCI registry via terraform registry-seeder module; 3) run installer with --preseed-bundle=<bundle-ref> or place bundle under installer/bundles/oci-lock/; 4) for upgrades use scripts/migrate-sealedkeys.sh --verify then --apply; 5) to rollback, installer records preseed bundle checksums in /var/lib/redwood-installer/credentials-checksums and the rollback hook restores previous controller secret if available.
test_plan: Unit tests for parsing and validation of signed bundle format; end-to-end airgap integration smoke test that verifies controller starts with preseeded private material, secrets can be unsealed by workloads, and migration script idempotency/resume behavior. Manual validation steps included in docs/upgrade-offline-credentials.md.
risk_assessment: Low-medium. Introducing new installer hook and key material handling increases blast radius if misused; mitigations: signed bundles must be validated, installer preflight blocks on malformed bundles, default Helm behavior preserves rotation unless explicitly disabled, and migration tool has dry-run and resume modes. Security review completed.
